data.titulo: Kunyagwa Kutwarwa mu Baburoni Kuhika ha Kugaruka kwombeka  Ebisiika bya Yerusalemu
data.contenido:
Obu bakaba bali mubunyagwa mu Baburoni, Abaisareri bakatunga okulengesebwa kw’okwikiriza kwabo. Saduraki, Mesaki na Abedenego bakanagwa mu mu’ro mwingi, kyonka Ruhanga akabacungura. Hanyuma, Abamedi n’Abaperesi obu basingwire Baburoni, Danieri akanagwa mukiina ky’entale, baitu Ruhanga yamujuna obu yakingire eminwa y’entale.

Hamperu, omukama Omuperesi, Kuro, akasumurra Abaisareri. Bakagarukayo mu nsi yabu hanyuma y’emyaka 70 kuruga obu batwairwe mubunyagwa mu Baburoni. Ekimu habibabandize kukora bamazire okugaruka Yerusalemu nukwo kutandika kwombeka yekaru ya Yahwe. Baitu abanyanzigwa bakemereza omulimu gwabu mukasumi kataito. Nahabwekyo kikabatwarra haihi emyaka 22 bamazire kugaruka Yerusalemu, kumaliriza kwombeka yekaru.

Ekirukugarukaho, nitwega hali orugendo rwa Ezera kugaruka Yerusalemu kuhunda yekaru. Kinu kikabaho emyaka nka 47 hanyuma y’okumaliriza yekaru. Emyaka 13 hanyuma y’orugendo runu orwa Ezera, Nehemiya akakonyera mukwombeka buhyaka ebisiika eby’ehingulirize Yerusalemi ebikaba bigwire. Ekicweka EKYAKATANO nikitwara emyaka 152 ey’ebyafaayo kuhikira kimu ha busumi bunu.

NOIJUKA, rundi okahurraho hali abasigazi banu abasatu? Ego, nubo banywani ba Danieri abayangire kulya ebitabasemerire. Abababuroni bakabeta Saduraki, Mesaki na Abedenego. Baitu barole hati. Habwaki batarukwinamira ekisisani kinu ekikooto nk’abandi boona? Katurole.

Noijuka ebiragiro bya Yahwe ebirukwetwa Ebiragiro Ikumi ebi yayehandikiire wenka? Ekyokubanza nikyo kinu: ‘Otaliramya baruhanga abandi kwihaho nyowe.’ Abasigazi hanu bakaba niborobera ekiragiro kinu, n’obu kiraba kyabaire kitanguhire.

Nebukadeneza, omukama wa Baburoni akaba ayesere abakungu kuha ekitiinisa ekisisani kinu eki yataireho. Hati yamara kugambira abantu boona ati: ‘Obu murahurra erika erye ikondere, n’enaanga, n’ebintu byona ebigamba, mugwe hansi muramye ekisisani kinu eky’ezabbu. Omuntu weena atainame rundi ataramye, aranagwa ahonaho hagati y’ekikomi ky’omu’ro.’

Baitu, Nebukadeneza obu yahulire nti Saduraki, Mesaki na Abedenego tibainamire ekisisani, akabihirwa muno. Yaragira babalete omu maisoge. Yabaha omugisa ogundi kukinamira. Baitu abasigazi banu nibesiga Yahwe. Bakagambira Nebukadeneza bati: ‘Ruhanga waitu ou tukuramya nasobora kutujuna, baitu n’obwatatujune, titurukwija kwinamira ekisisani kyawe eky’ezabbu.’

Abu yahulire binu, Nebukadeneza akaijura ekiniga. Hakaba haroho ekikomi ky’omu’ro haihi, kandi nukwo kuragira ati: ‘Mwongere ekibabu ky’omu’ro emirundi musanju okukira okugwakaga butosa!’ Yaragira abasaija emanzi okuboha Saduraki, Mesaki, na Abedenego babanage omu mu’ro omwingi ogurukwaka. Habwomu’ro kwokya muno, ekibabu ky’omu’ro kikaita abasaija abo abahimbire Saduraki, Mesaki na Abedenego. Baitu kiki ekyahikire h’abasigazi banu basatu?

Omukama arora omu mu’ro kandi atiina muno. Akaguza: ‘Titunagire basaija basatu ababoherwe hagati y’ekikomi ky’omu’ro?’

‘Ego nukwo,’ abahereza be bagarukamu.

Agamba ati: ‘Baitu nindora abasaija bbana abalekirwe nibagendera hagati y’omu’ro kunu tibaroho kabi. Kandi owakana nasisana nk’omwana wa Ruhanga.’ Omukama airra haihi n’ekikomi ky’omu’ro, kandi ayamirra ati: ‘Saduraki, na Mesaki na Abedenego!, abairu ba Ruhanga anyakuli haiguru muno, Murugeyo!’

Obu barugiremu, buli muntu wena akarora ngu tibahikirweho kabi koona. Omukama nukwo kwongera kugamba ati: ‘Asiimwe Ruhanga wa Saduraki, Mesaki na Abedenego! Atumire maraika kandi yabajuna habwokuba tibaikirize kwinamira rundi kuramya ruhanga weena, kwihaho owabu wenka.’

Kinu tikiri ekyokurorraho eky’obwesigwa hali Yahwe eki tusemerire kuhondera?Okuruga 20:3; Danieri 3:1-30. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

KIKI ekirukukorwa hanu? Abantu bakaba ha bugenyi bw’amaani. Omukama wa Baburoni ayesere abagenyi ab’ekitiinisa rukumi. Nibakozesa ebikopo bya zabbu na feeza ebyaihirwe omu yekaru ya Yahwe omu Yerusalemu. Baitu, mukaanya ako, hakazooka enkumu z’omukono gw’omuntu zitandika kuhandika ha kisiika. Abantu boona batiina muno.

Berisaza mwijukuru wa Nebukadeneza nuwe mukama hati. Ayamirra haiguru nti abamagezi be baleetebwe omunju nambere akaba ali. Abagambira ati: ‘Omuntu weena arasoma ekihandiko kinu, akansoborra amakuru gaakyo, arahebwa ebisembo bingi kandi abe omulemi omukuru owakasatu mu bukama bunu.’ Baitu tiharoho n’omu h’abasaija abamagezi ayasoboire kusoma ekihandiiko kyaha kisiika n’obukwakuba kusoborra amakuru gakyo.

Nyina omukama ahurra okutoka kandi aija omukisiika kinu eky’obugenyi. Agambira omukama ati: ‘Leka kweralikirra. Haroho omusaija omubukama bwawe anyakumanyire abaruhanga abarukwera. Swenkuru Nebukaduneza obwakaba ali mukama akamufoora mukuru wa bamagezibe boona. Ibaralye nuwe Danieri. Mumwete, naija kusoborra amakuru.’

Mubwangu Danieri bamuleeta. Hanyuma y’okwanga kuhebwa ebisembo byona, Danieri atandikira hakusoborra habwaki kara Yahwe yabaire aihire Nebukadeneza isenkuru Berusaza ha nteebe y’obukama. Danieri agamba: ‘Akaba ali w’emyehembo, nikyo kyaletiire Yahwe kumufubira.’

Danieri agambira Berisaza: ‘Iwe okamanya ebyamubaireho, baitu okyaina emyehembo nka Nebukadeneza. Olesere ebikopo n’ebibindi ebya yekaru ya Yahwe kandi wabinyweramu. Okugiize baruhanga abakozirwe omumiti n’omu mabale, baitu tohaire Ruhanga waitu ekitiinisa. Nikyo Ruhanga atumire omukono kuhandiika ebigambo binu.’ Danieri agamba ati: ‘Kinu nikyo ekihandikirwe, MENE, MENE, TEKELI, UFASINI.’

‘MENE nikimanyisa ngu Ruhanga abazire ebiro by’obukama bwawe kandi abumazireho. TEKELI nikimanyisa ngu olengerwe omu minzani, baitu ozokere otarukuhika. UFASINI nikimanyisa ngu obukama bwawe buhairwe Abamedi n’Abaperesi.’

Danieri nobu akaba nakyabaza, Abamedi n’Abaperesi bakaba batandikire okurumba Baburoni. Bakakwata orubuga kandi baita Berisaza. Ekihandiko kyaha kisiika kyahikirra ekiro ekyo! Baitu kiki ekikaba nikiija kuhika ha Baisareri hati? Nitwija kukizoora omumaiso aho, baitu katubanze twetegereze ekirahika ha Danieri.Danieri 5:1-31. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

MAHANO! Danieri nazooka ali mukasumi akabi. Kyonka entale tizimuliire! Nomanya habwaki? Oha ayataire Danieri omuntale zinu zona? Katukizoole.

Omukama arukulema Baburoni hati nayetwa Daliyo. Nagonza Danieri muno, habwokuba Danieri aine embabazi kandi w’amagezi. Daliyo akakoma Danieri kuba omulemi omukuru mubukama bwe. Kinu kikaleetera abakuru abandi omubukama bunu kukwatirwa Danieri ihali, nahabwekyo bacwamu kugira ekibaakora.

Bakagenda hali Daliyo kandi bamugambira bati: ‘Itwe tucwiremu Ai omukama, okole ekiragiro ekirukuragira ngu omuntu weena aleeke kusaba ruhanga ondi weena rundi omuntu ondi weena kwihaho iwe omukama kumara ebiro 30. Kakuba omuntu weena ajeema, anagwe mukiina haali entale.’ Daliyo atamanye habwaki abasaija banu nibenda ekiragiro kinu kikorwe. Baitu habwokuba akatekereza ngu kitekerezo kirungi, nukwo kuhandikisa ekiragiro kinu. Ekiragiro kinu tikisobora kuhindurwa.

Danieri obuyahulire eby’ekiragiro kinu, yagenda omunju ye, yasaba nkoku yakoraga butoosa. Abasaija banu ababi bakaba nibakimanya ngu Danieri akaba takusobora kuleka kusaba Yahwe. Bakasemererwa habwokuba entegeka yabu ey’okuhwerekereza Danieri ekaba nezooka nkerukugenda kuhiki’ra.

Omukama Daliyo obu yayetegerize ensonga eyaletiire abasaija banu kutekaho ekiragiro kinu, akasaasa. Baitu akaba atarukusobora kuhindura ekiragiro kinu, nahabwekyo akaba aine kuragira Danieri anagwe omu kiina ky’entale. Kyonka omukama akagambira Danieri ati: ‘Kanihire Ruhanga waawe ow’orukuhereza naija kukujuna.’ Habwokutatekana, Daliyo atasobole n’okubyama ekiro ekyo. Obu bwakiire, akairuka yagenda ha kiina ky’entale. Norora nuho ali. Yayamirra: ‘Danieri, omuhereza wa Ruhanga omwomezi! Ruhanga ow’orukuhereza asoboire kukujuna entale?’

Danieri amugarakamu ati: ‘Ruhanga atumire maraika we yaigarra eminwa y’entale tizisoboire kunkoraho akabi koona.’

Omukama asemererwa muno. Aragira Danieri okwihibwa mu kiina ky’entale. Nukwo aragira ngu abasaija bali ababi abakaba nibenda kuhwerekereza Danieri banagwe omukiina ky’entale. Obu bakaba batakahikire hansi omu kiina ky’entale, entale zibagwera zibacwa amagufa gabu goona.

Hanyuma, omukama Daliyo ahandikira abantu boona ab’omubukama bwe ati: ‘Nindagira nti buli muntu aine kuha Ruhanga wa Danieri ekitiinisa. Nakora ebyamahano by’amaani. Ajunire Danieri butaliibwa entale.’Danieri 6:1-28. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

data.titulo: Abantu ba Ruhanga Baruga mu Baburoni
data.contenido:
HAHINGWIREHO emyaka nk’ebiri okuruga obu Abamedi n’Abaperesi bahamba Baburoni. Dora ebirukubaho hati! Abaisareri nibaruga omu Baburoni. Bakacungurwa bata? Noha abaikirize kugenda?

Kuro, omukama wa Peresi nuwe akikozere. Kara muno, Kuro atakazairwe, Yahwe akakozesa omurangi we Isaya kumuhandikaho ati: ‘Oija kukora ekinkwenda okole. Enyigi ziija kulekwa zikingwirwe osobole kukwata ekibuga.’ Mali Kuro akebembera kukwata orubuga rwa Baburoni. Abamedi n’Abaperesi bakataaha mu rubuga ekiro nibaraba mu nyigi azalekerwe zikingwirwe.

Baitu omurangi wa Yahwe Isaya akaba ayongire yagamba ngu Kuro akaba nagenda kuragira Yerusalemu na yekaru byombekwe buhyaka. Kuro akaha ekiragiro kinu? Mali akakiha. Kinu nikyo Kuro yagambiire Abaisareri: ‘Mugende hati Yerusalemu kandi mwombeke yekaru ya Yahwe, Ruhanga wanyu.’ Nikyo Abaisareri banu barukugenda kukora.

Kyonka Abaisareri boona batasobole kukwata orugendo oruraira okugaruka Yerusalemu. Rugendo ruraira orwa mailo nka 500 kandi baingi baali bakuzire muno rundi barwaire, batakusobora kugenda hara. Kandi haroho n’ensonga ezindi ezalemeseze abandi kugenda. Baitu Kuro agambira abo abatarukugarukayo: ‘Muhe effeza n’ezabbu n’ebisembo abo abarukugarukayo kwombeka Yerusalemu na yekaru.’

Ebisembo bingi bihebwa Abaisareri banu abarukugenda Yerusalemu. Na Kuro abaha ebikopo n’ebibindi ebyabaga munju ya Yahwe omukama Nebukadeneza ebyakaba aihire mu yekaru ya Yahwe obu yahwerekereza Yerusalemu. Abantu baali baina ebintu bingi eby’okwetweka obu bakaba nibagarukayo.

Hanyuma y’emwezi ena nibagenda, Abaisareri bakahika Yerusalemu mu bwire bwenyini. Gikaba myaka 70 kuruga obu orubuga rwahwerekerezebwa kandi ensi ekaba esigaire matongo. Baitu nobukiraba kiri nti Abaisareri bagarukire omu nsi yabo, bakaba nibagenda kutunga emihito nkoku turukugenda kumanya.Isaya 44:28; 45:1-4; Ezera 1:1-11. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

ABANTU nka 50,000 bakwasire omuhanda kuruga Baburoni kugenda Yerusalemu. Baitu obu bahikire Yerusalemu bakasanga esisikaire. Tiharimu muntu weena. Nukwo Abaisareri bakaba baine kwombeka buli kintu buhyaka.

Ekibabandize kwombeka kikaba ekyoto. Hanu nuho bahongeraga Yahwe ebihongwa. Emyezi mike mumaiso, Abaisareri bakatandika kwombeka yekaru. Baitu abanyanzigwa abakaba nibaikara mu nsi za haihi bakaba batarukugoza Abaisareri bagyombeke. Bakalengaho kubatiinisiriza nukwo bagireke. Hanyuma, abanyanzigwa banu bakaletera omukama omuhyaka owa Peresi okutekaho ekiragiro eky’okwemereza omulimu gw’okwombeka.

Obusumi bukarabaho. Hati giri myaka 17 kuruga Abaisareri baruga Baburoni. Yahwe atuma abarangi be Hagai na Zekaliya kugambira abantu kugaruka kutandika kwombeka. Abantu besiga Yahwe okubaha okukonyezi, kandi bahuliriza abarangi. Bagarukamu kwombeka n’obukiraba ekiragiro kyabaire nikibatanga.

Omukungu omu ow’Abaperesi ayayetwaga Tatenayi aija akaguza Abaisareri ayabaikiriize okwombeka yekaru. Abaisareri bamugambira ngu obu bakaba bali omu Baburoni, omukama Kuro akabagamba ati: ‘Mugende hati Yerusalemu kandi mwombeke yekaru ya Yahwe Ruhanga wanyu.’

Tatenayi ahandika ebbaruha agitweka Baburoni akaguze mali Kuro ayabaire afiire, obwaraba nukwo yagambire. Mukaanya kake ebbaruha kuruga hali omukama omuhyaka ow’Abaperesi eija. Egamba nti nukwo Kuro yagambire. Kandi omukama ahandiika ati: ‘Leka Abaisareri bombeke yekaru ya Ruhanga wabu. Kandi ninkuragira kubaha obukonyezi.’ Mu myaka ena, yekaru ekamalirizibwa, kandi Abaisareri basemererwa muno.

Emyaka nyingi ekahinguraho. Hati haihi myaka 48 kuruga yekaru emalirizibwa. Abantu mu Yerusalemu baseege, kandi ekibuga na yekaru ya Ruhanga tibirukusisana kurungi. Mu Baburoni, Omuisareri arukwetwa Ezera atunga okumanyisibwa nti yekaru ya Ruhanga esemerire kusemezebwa. Nomanya eki yakozere?

Ezera agenda kurora Atakisakisi, omukama wa Peresi. Kandi omukama onu omurungi akaha Ezera ebisembo bingi ebyokutwara Yerusalemu. Nukwo Ezera kugambira Abaisareri abakaba mu Baburoni kumukonyera kutwara ebisembo binu Yerusalemu. Abantu 6,000 bagamba nti nibaija kugenda. Baina efeeza n’ezabbu nyingi n’ebintu ebindi ebyomuhendo bingi ebibaina kutwara.

Ezera ayeralikirra habwokuba abasaija ababi bali mumuhanda. Abasaija banu basobora kubatwaraho feeza n’ezabbu yabu kandi babaite. Ezera ayeta abantu baije hamu, nkoku orukurora mukisisani. Hati basaba Yahwe okubalinda omu rugendo oruraira okugaruka Yerusalemu.

Yahwe abalinda. Hanyuma y’emwezi enna murugendo, baahika Yerusalemu mubusinge. Kinu tikirukwoleka ngu Yahwe nasobora kulinda abo abamwesiga?Ezera suura 2 kuhika 8. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

TUGENDE enyumaho Ezera atakagenzere Yerusalemu. Morodekai na Esiteri nubo bali Abaisareri eb’ekitiinisa mubukama bwa Peresi. Esiteri nuwe omugo, kandi omwana wa isento Moredekai nuwe arukugaruka hali omukama mubusobozi. Leka twetegereze nkoku binu byabaireho.

Abazaire ba Esiteri bakafa obwakaba akyali muto muno, kandi nikyo Morodekai yamukuliize. Ahasuero omukama w’Abaperesi aine ekikaali mu rubuga rwa Susani, kandi Morodekai ali omu h’abahereza be. Kale kiro kimu, omugo w’omukama Vasiti akanga kumworobera, nahabwekyo, omukama akakoma omukazi omuhyaka abe omugo. Nomanya omukazi ou yakomere? Mali ni Esiteri akaba ali muto kandi murungi munno. Norora omusaija onu ow’emyehembo abantu ou barukwinamira? Onu nuwe Hamani omusaija mukuru muno omu Peresi. Nayenda Morodekai, oworukurora aikalire hanu, nawe kumwinamira. Baitu Morodekai tasobora kukikora. Takutekereza nti kihikire kwinamira omusaija onu omubi. Kinu kikaletera Hamani kutunga ekiniga ky’amaani. Hati kinu nikyo yakozere.

Hamani akagambira omukama ebisuba h’Abaisareri. Akagamba ati: ‘Bantu babi abatarukworobera ebiragiro byawe. Basemerire kwitwa.’ Ahasuero tamanyire ngu omugo Esiteri ali omu h’Abaisareri. Akahuliriza Hamani kandi yatekaho ekiragiro ngu ekiro kimu, Abaisareri boona bakaba b’okwitwa.

Morodekai obu yahulire ekiragiro ekyo yatuntura. Yatuma hali Esiteri ati: ‘Oine kugambira omukama, omwesengereze atujune.’ Nikicwa ebiragiro mu Peresi kugenda kurora omukama kwihaho uwe bwaba akusembiize. Kyonka Esiteri akagenda hali omukama atamusembize. Omukama yaimukya omwigogwe ogwa zabbu haliwe ekirukumanyisa ngu taina kwitwa. Esiteri ayeta omukama na Hamani okwija ha bugenyi. Hanu omukama akaguza Esiteri ekyarukwenda amukorre. Esiteri agamba nti naija kumugambira uwe na Hamani obubaraija ha kihuro ekiro ekirakurataho.

Ha kihuro kinu, Esiteri akagambira omukama ati: ‘Abantu bange nanye nitugenda kwitwa.’ Omukama akwatwa ekiniga. Akaguza ati: ‘Noha arukulengaho kukora ekintu nkekyo?’

Esiteri agarukamu ati: ‘Omuntu ogu omunyanzigwa nuwe onu Hamani omubi.’

Hati omukama abihirwa muno. Aragira ngu Hamani aitwe. Hanyuma omukama afoora Morodekai owakabiri mubusobozi haliwe. Morodekai atekaho ekiragiro ekirukubaikiriza kurwanirra obwomezi bwabo ha kiro ekibakaba nibagenda kwitirwaho. Habwokuba Morodekai muntu w’ekitiinisa, abantu baingi bakonyera Abaisareri, kandi bakizibwa kuruga mubanyanzigwa babu.Ekitabu kya Esiteri. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA omulimo gwona ogurukugenda mumaiso hanu. Hanu Abaisareri nibakora muno okwombeka ebisiika bya Yerusalemu. Omukama Nebukadeneza obu yahwerekerize Yerusalemu emyaka 152 ey’enyuma, akacwa ebisiika, kandi yayokya emiryango y’orubuga. Abaisareri batatandikire hakwombeka ebisiika obu bagarukireyo owabubo kuruga Baburoni.

Notekereza abantu bakahurra bata okwikara hanu emyaka enu yoona bataina ebisiika ebyehingulirize orubuga rwabu? Ebyokwerinda tibiri kurungi. Abanyanzigwa babu bakaba nibasobora kwija bwangu okubarumba. Baitu hati onu omusaija Nehemiya nakonyera abantu okwombeka ebisiika buhyaka. Omanyire Nehemiya nuwe araha?

Nehemiya Muisareri arukuruga mu rubuga rwa Susani nambere Morodekai na Esiteri habaikaraga. Nehemiya yakorraga mukikaali ky’omukama, kandi nasobora kuba yaali munywani wa Morodekai n’omugo Esiteri. Baitu Baibuli tesoborra nti akakorra iba wa Esiteri, Omukama Ahasuero. Akakorra omukama ayagarukireho, omukama Atakisakisi.

Ijuka, Atakisakisi nuwe omukama omurungi ayahaire Ezera sente zoona kutwara Yerusalemu kuhunda yekaru ya Yahwe. Baitu Ezera atombeke ebisiika ebigyehingulirize. Katwetegereze nkoku kyasobokere Nehemiya kukora omulimo gunu.

Emyaka 13 ehingwireho kuruga Atakisakisi aha Ezera sente kuhunda Yekaru. Nehemiya nuwe hati omwambukya omukuru ow’omukama Atakisakisi. Kinu nikimanyisa nti nuwe ahereza omukama eviini kandi arora nti omukama tahebwa obutwa. Gunu mulimo mukuru muno.

Kale kiro kimu, mugenzi wa Nehemiya, Hanani n’abasaija abandi kuruga mu nsi ya Isareri bakaija kubungira Nehemiya. Bamugambira emitalibaine ei Abaisareri baine, kandi nkoku ebisiika ebyehingulirize Yerusalemu bikyasisikaire. Kinu kiretera Nehemiya kutuntura muno kandi ekintu ekyo akisaba hali Yahwe.

Kiro kimu, omukama arora ngu Nehemiya tasemerirwe, nukwo kumukaguza: ‘Habwaki oyeralikiriire?’ Nehemiya amugambira ati nahabwa Yerusalemu kuba omu mulingo omubi kandi n’ebisiika ebigyehingulirize bigwire hansi. Omukama amukaguza ati: ‘Kiki eky’orukwenda?’

Nehemiya amugamba ati: ‘Nyikiriza ngende Yerusalemu, nsobole kwombeka ebisiika.’ Omukama Atakisakisi w’embabazi nyingi. Agambira Nehemiya ngu agende kandi amukonyera kutunga embaho z’okukozesa mukwombekesa. Mukasumi kake, Nehemiya amazire kuhika Yerusalemu agambira abantu entekaniza ze. Basiima ekitekerezo kye, kandi bagamba bati: ‘Tutandike kwombeeka.’ Abanyanzigwa b’Abaisareri obu barozire okwombeka nikugenda omumaiso, bagamba: ‘Nitwija kugenda tubaite n’omulimu gw’okwombeka tugwemereze.’ Binu Nehemiya akabihurra, nukwo kuha abakozi empirima n’amacumu. Akabagamba: ‘Mutatiina abanyazigwa baitu. Murwanirre bagenzi banyu, abaana banyu, abakazi banyu n’amaka ganyu.’

Abantu bakaba bamanzi. Bakaba bulindaara n’eby’okurwanisa byabu nyamusana n’ekiro, kandi bakeyongera kwombeka. Mubiro 52 byonka, ebisiika bikaba bihoire kwombekwa. Hati abantu baine obusinge mu rubuga. Nehemiya na Ezera bayegesa abantu ebiragiro bya Ruhanga kandi abantu basemererwa.

Baitu ebintu tibiri nkoku bikaba biri Abaisareri batakatwairwe nk’abanyankomo mu Baburoni. Abantu nibakyalemwa omukama wa Buperesi kandi baine kumuhereza. Baitu Yahwe akanihiza kutekaho omukama omuhyaka, kandi akagamba ngu omukama onu naija kuletera abantu obusinge. Omukama onu nuwe oha? Naija kuleta ata obusinge mu nsi? Hakahinguraho emyaka 450 ebintu ebikukwata hali kinu bitarukumanywa. Kiro kimu habaho okuzaarwa kw’omwana okukuru. Baitu runu ruganikyo rundi.Nehemiya suura 1 kuhika 6. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega
